display_long_description:
Horror Mansion - Elanor's Villa

Something is wrong with the old villa.

For years, locals have reported strange noises, unexplained disappearances, and sightings of a mysterious woman wandering the halls after dark. Most who enter never stay long enough to discover the truth.

As an investigator, you must explore the abandoned mansion, search for hidden clues, unlock forgotten areas, and uncover the dark secrets buried within its walls.

But you are not alone.

A presence watches your every move. Whispers echo through empty corridors. Doors open on their own. Shadows move where no one should be.

The deeper you venture into the villa, the closer you come to discovering the truth behind Eleanor and the curse that binds her to this place.

Will you find the courage to continue... or become another lost soul trapped within the mansion?

Features

• Immersive VR horror experience
• Explore a mysterious haunted mansion
• Solve environmental puzzles and uncover secrets
• Search for hidden ritual fragments
• Atmospheric sound design and paranormal events
• Intense jump scares and psychological horror moments
• Story-driven investigation experience
• Designed exclusively for Virtual Reality

Warning

This game contains intense horror, jump scares, flashing lights, disturbing imagery, and loud sounds. Player discretion is advised.

Enter the villa if you dare. Eleanor is waiting. 👁️🏚️🕯️
